description: Type Analytics Hub's 400 for deleting a query template that left the DRAFTED state. Observed live 2026-10-29: after submit or approve, delete answers 400 'QueryTemplate must be in DRAFTED state to be deleted.' It surfaced as an out-of-union BadRequest. Such a template is removed only with its data exchange.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The query template was submitted or approved, so it can't be deleted on its own (HTTP 400: 'QueryTemplate must be in DRAFTED state to be deleted'). Deleting its data exchange removes it.

message.includes: must be in DRAFTED state to be deleted
